reuse.why: Routes the averaging actions through the existing setNMonthAvg and introduces one shared category selection, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own path instead of using it.

duplication.why: Removes the three copied average loops and SQL, but the hidden/hidden-group/template rule now exists twice (SQL in getMonthActionCategories and JS checks in copyPreviousMonth), and the income/tracking skip stays repeated in setZero, setNMonthAvgForAllCategories and copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: Selection helper and changes live in budget/actions.ts alongside the actions.

scope.why: Consolidating set3/6/12MonthAvg goes slightly beyond the request but is directly tied to applying the new selection once.

maintainability.why: A future change to which categories month-wide actions touch must be made in both the SQL helper and copyPreviousMonth's per-row checks, and the income rule is still outside the helper.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth re-decides hidden/group_hidden/goal_def per budget row in JS while getMonthActionCategories encodes the same rule as SQL WHERE clauses

one_place.where: getMonthActionCategories (setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg) and separately the inline hidden/group_hidden/goal_def checks in copyPreviousMonth over getBudgetData
